Upside down. Nothing to push on.
Cat person or dog person?
This cat is falling
upside down,
with nothing to push on.
In 1894,
scientists thought
it cheated,
pushing off the hand.
It did not.
It bends in the middle,
and turns each half
on its own.
Front legs tucked in,
the front half spins
round,
while the stretched-out
back barely moves.
Then it swaps,
and the back half
catches up. Feet down.
But from very low,
it runs out of time to turn.
